name: PixMo-Count
intro: PixMo-Count 是 Ai2 在 Molmo 与 PixMo 工作中发布的开放视觉计数数据集。它使用 Detic 在网页图像上检测对象，经严格置信度和多样性过滤后生成对象中心点与计数问答，并对 2 至 10 个对象的验证集和测试集进行人工核验。
org: Allen Institute for AI, University of Washington
build_method: Detic非VLM检测, 严格置信度与多样性过滤, 对象中心点计数问答, 人工核验评测集
task_type: 视觉计数问答, 对象中心点指点
eval_feature: Detic自动构建, 0至10计数训练, 2至10人工核验评测, Point-then-Count
build_method_en: Non-VLM Detic detection, strict confidence and diversity filtering, object-center counting QA, human-verified evaluation sets
eval_feature_en: Detector-built data, 0-to-10 training counts, human-verified 2-to-10 evaluation, point-then-count
intro_en: PixMo-Count is an open visual counting dataset released by Ai2 with Molmo and PixMo. It runs Detic on web images, applies strict confidence and diversity filtering, derives object-center points and counting QA pairs, and manually verifies validation and test examples with counts from 2 to 10.
drawio_review_note: Corrected and aligned with arXiv:2409.17146, the CVPR 2025 Molmo and PixMo paper, the official allenai/molmo repository, and the official allenai/pixmo-count dataset card. PixMo-Count is an Ai2 dataset rather than a Gemini Robotics benchmark. A standard non-VLM Detic detector runs on web images; after strict confidence thresholding, the class with the most detections is selected and object centers become point supervision. The pipeline filters for accuracy and diversity and forms image counting-QA pairs. For counts 2 through 10, 120 samples per count are manually verified to create 540-record validation and test splits; those evaluation records omit points. The released training split has 36,916 records with counts 0 through 10, labels, and center points. The ODC-BY dataset publishes URLs and SHA-256 hashes. Evaluation reports counting Accuracy and the paper shows point-then-count outperforming direct count generation.
